$Comment: Light the Hollow Lantern with Old Jack in several seasons. The Lantern quest comes back once a
year, so each season's lighting adds one, and the criterion's Amount is how many it takes.
It has no Parent, so it is one achievement kept across the years rather than a yearly copy, and
it carries no hallowed tag, so The Hallowed never waits on it. It pays the title
Hallows_Eve_Keeper_Of_Lanterns through the Title reward kind, Auto since a title needs no bag
room. The description's number comes from the Amount through @amount.
